cim_eredeti: President Trump says he "would not mind" the reinstatement of Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO and "I don't know that she was a spy at all", referencing Alice Huang (Emily Goodin/New York Post)
szoveg_eredeti:
WASHINGTON — President Donald Trump said Monday he “would not mind” if Jensen Huang was reinstated as Nvidia CEO, claiming that the tech boss had “learned a big lesson” from his romantic entanglement with a suspected Chinese spy.

“I guess maybe one lesson is more important than another, but I would certainly not mind seeing that,” Trump told reporters as he left the White House for a trip to the Philippines and China in response to a Financial Times report that Huang had put together a “war room” of Silicon Valley executives to lobby for his return.

Huang stepped down Friday following revelations of a series of extramarital affairs, including one with Alice Huang (no relation), an executive at a Singapore-based Nvidia client suspected by US intelligence of being in the pay of Beijing.

“I don’t know that she’s a Chinese spy,” Trump said of Alice Huang, reflecting reported internal dissension over the intelligence community’s assessment.

This is a developing story. Please check back for updates.
